pokedexEntries.di: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.prl: It likes places where people gather. It mimics foes to confuse them, then makes its getaway.

pokedexEntries.pt: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

pokedexEntries.hgss: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

pokedexEntries.or: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

pokedexEntries.y: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.as: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.us: It does its absolute best to mimic the movements and expressions of its opponents, but it’s still not very good at it.

pokedexEntries.um: When this gifted mimic surprises an opponent, Mime Jr. feels so happy that it ends up forgetting it was imitating something.

pokedexEntries.sw: It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.

pokedexEntries.sh: It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps like an apprentice.

pokedexEntries.bd: It habitually mimics foes. The mimicked foe is said to be unable to look away from Mime Jr.

pokedexEntries.shp: It likes places where people gather. It mimics foes to confuse them, then makes its getaway.

pokedexEntries.la: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

pokedexEntries.za: Mime Jr. is a gifted mimic. When it startles an opponent with its skills, it feels so delighted that it forgets to keep up its act.
